title: Whispering Whelk Wizard
statement: A pearly spiral-shelled snail in a tiny pointed hat of kelp, who drifts across a moonlit sandy bed trailing sparkles of bioluminescent plankton and murmuring soft bubbles at sleepy anemones. Around him, a ring of mossy stones, a sunken teacup and slow-swaying sea grass glow in deep teal and lavender, as if the tank itself were listening to his spells.
